title: Console UI: Shadow Experiment results (quality deltas + drilldowns)
creator: Dylan Brooks
project: Shadow traffic tool for eval metrics
description:
Build the Console UI experience for viewing Shadow Experiment results: quality deltas vs control, confidence intervals, segment filters, and drilldowns into scored examples.

This ticket is UI-only: it assumes the Console backend can create/query experiments and fetch aggregates + examples (ENG-5407) and that telemetry/scoring events exist (ENG-5404/5405). UI must be safe-by-default (PII handling callouts, redaction indicators) and resilient to missing/lagging scoring signals.

References
- Confluence UX spec: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/console-shadow-experiments-ux-spec.json
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/shadow-traffic-eval-metrics-prd.json
- Dashboard mockups: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/observability/shadow-metrics-dashboard-mockups.json

Scope
1) Shadow Experiments results page
- Summary header: experiment name, route, control variant, shadow targets, sampling %, time range, current state (running/stopped), rubric version.
- KPI tiles (control vs shadow + delta): overall score, format adherence, refusal rate, safety flags, instruction-following rubric score.
- “Data freshness” indicator: last scored timestamp + scoring lag state (OK / delayed / stalled). If delayed, show guidance + link to runbook.

2) Delta charting components
- Time series for selected metric with confidence band (CI) and a delta-over-control line.
- Compare modes: overall vs segmented (region, request_type, route, model_id); only allow cardinality-safe segments provided by API.
- Tooltip behavior: show sample size (n), control mean, shadow mean, delta, CI.
- Guardrails: if n below threshold, show “insufficient sample size” state and hide CI.

3) Segment filters + table
- Filter bar: time range, shadow target, request type (chat/completions/embeddings if exposed), region, outcome (scored/unscored/error), metric.
- Segment table listing top segments by traffic with delta + CI + sample size. Must be paginated and stable-sorted.

4) Example drilldown
- Examples list with sampling controls (API-driven), showing: request_id hash, timestamp, redaction status, control output excerpt, shadow output excerpt, per-example rubric breakdown.
- Detail drawer for a single example: full prompt/context (redacted), full outputs (redacted), scoring rationale (model-graded text) if available, and tags like “partial (streaming)” when applicable.
- Export: “Download CSV (aggregates)” and “Export examples (JSONL)” buttons gated by permission + retention settings.

5) UX content + warnings
- Inline callouts: ‘Shadow traffic does not affect user responses’, ‘Scores are asynchronous’, ‘Prompts/outputs may be redacted/truncated’, ‘Short retention by default’.
- Link out to docs quickstart and runbook.

Non-goals
- UI for creating experiments (covered in separate ticket / earlier milestone).
- Arbitrary offline replay.
- Customer custom eval code.

Implementation notes
- Frontend stack: Console web (React/TS), reuse existing Rollouts chart primitives where possible.
- All requests must support cancellation on navigation (avoid long-running queries when the user changes time range/filters).
- Prefer server-side pagination for examples; do not fetch full payload for list view.
- Feature flag: console.shadow_experiments_results (defaults off; enabled for internal dogfood + beta tenants).
- RBAC: respect backend permission errors; do not infer existence of experiments from error states.

Acceptance criteria
- Results page renders for an experiment with at least one shadow target and shows:
  - summary header + KPI tiles
  - at least one delta chart with CI
  - segment table w/ pagination
  - examples list + detail drawer
- Handles degraded modes:
  - scoring lag: show banner + ‘data freshness’ indicator
  - missing metrics: show empty states with explanation (no hard crashes)
  - redacted fields: visibly marked (badge + tooltip)
- Performance: page interactive < 2s on warm load for typical experiments (aggregate payload only); examples load on demand.
- Works in Hosted + Dedicated tenants (Private may have subset depending on config; UI must tolerate missing export endpoints).

Test plan (UI)
- Unit tests: chart component rendering with/without CI, sample-size thresholds, formatting of deltas.
- Integration tests: filter changes cause API calls; pagination; drawer open/close; export disabled w/o permission.
- E2E (Playwright): open experiment -> verify KPIs -> switch metric -> drill into example -> verify redaction badge.

Open questions
- Final metric names + grouping for UI labels vs backend keys (needs alignment w/ observability standard).
- Do we show ‘advisory only’ vs ‘auto rollback enabled’ on the page when attached to a rollout? (PM leaning advisory for beta.)
